verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a public API (api-reference/overview, agent-run-logs endpoint), a Python SDK for programmatic agent control, and a CLI, all explicitly aimed at driving agents programmatically (e.g., triggering from CI/CD, retrieving traces). This directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to drive the product via documented API/SDK. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
